title.narrative: Trust Fund for Consultative Group to Assist the Poorest (CGAP)

description.narrative: CGAP will fund a few networks to work with interested partnerscomma to develop and test out possible indicators for tracking client level changes. CGAP will work with the networks to ensure consensus on one common reporting format for the industrycomma i.e. one indicator for each MDG to ensure comparisons across institutions. $180comma000 will be used for grants and $60comma000 for consultants.
